name: CWSL Lotto 1049
author: Charlene Copeland

sections.description:
CWSL Lotto 1049 provides a frontend form for your users to enter their lotto numbers for each draw.

Players select 10 numbers between 1 and 49. They may select 1 set of 10 numbers or 3 sets.

Each time a Lotto 649 is run, enter the winning numbers in the back end and run the results. The first player to match 10 numbers to those selected in the Lotto 649 win!

Pre-requisites:
None

Features

  • Players can enter their own numbers
  • Administrators can manage each lotto draw, enter Lotto649 numbers and track payments.
sections.installation:
The easiest way to install CWSL Lotto 1049 is via your WordPress Dashboard. Go to the “Plugins” screen, click “Add New”, and search for “CWSL Lotto 1049” in the WordPress Plugin Directory. Then, click “Install Now” and wait a moment. Finally, click “Activate” and start using the plugin!

Manual installation works just as for other WordPress plugins:

  1. Download and extract the ZIP file.
  2. Move the folder “cwsl-lotto-1049” to the “wp-content/plugins/” directory of your WordPress installation, e.g. via FTP.
  3. Activate the plugin “CWSL Lotto 1049” on the “Plugins” screen of your WordPress Dashboard.
  4. Create a page for players to review and submit their numbers. Add the shortcode [cwslPublicAddNumbersForm]
  5. Review the submitted items in the WordPress admin area.
